name: Bags
author: brodgar
description: Example addon (Phase 3c): hafen.ui.replace — replace the native inventory with a custom read-only view that draws the REAL items at their real grid positions ('wrap, don't reimplement', D-009). DORMANT until you press Ctrl+Shift+I (remappable under Options > Keybindings > Bags): that adopts the live inventory as a hidden model and shows the custom Bags window; press again — or disable/reload the addon — to restore the stock inventory. Registering replace also re-finds an ALREADY-OPEN inventory (the :reload case). Item moving (take/transfer/drop) is the gated Phase-4 actions tier, so the view is read-only (a click logs the item).
